cursor: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production mouse/iDrive pointer cursor for an original classic Doodle Jump port. Create ONE isolated northwest-pointing arrow cursor on a truly transparent background. Match the classic game's hand-drawn notebook look: confident slightly irregular dark graphite/black ink outline, pale lime-green colored-pencil fill, a small cream highlight, a tiny understated spring-like kink in the tail. The sharp pointing tip is the extreme upper-left of the shape and is the click hotspot; the arrow body extends down and right. Bold simple silhouette and thick readable outline that remains clear at about 32 by 40 screen pixels. Flat 2D hand-drawn game sprite, clean alpha edge, no canvas/paper rectangle behind it, no surrounding scene, no shadow, no glow, no text, no multiple variants. Fill most of the image with the single cursor, with only a little transparent safety margin.
icon: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square app-launcher icon for original classic Doodle Jump on BMW MGU. Create one finished square icon, no surrounding UI. The classic lime/yellow-green Doodler character in side profile facing right, jumping above one small bright green platform. Recognizable original character: rounded bean-shaped upright head/body, protruding long rounded snout toward the right, tiny dark eye, several dark horizontal stripes on the lower torso, four short little feet, rough charcoal/black hand-drawn contour. Cheerful expressive upward jumping pose. Warm cream graph-paper background fills the entire square, fine pale orange notebook grid; a couple of restrained pencil motion strokes. Original classic 2D hand-drawn colored-pencil game aesthetic, not 3D. Large clear character silhouette occupying roughly two thirds of the icon, generous clean margins so it reads at 80 to 140 pixels. No words, no letters, no logo text, no badges, no app-store frame, no glossy effects, no watermark. The app name is displayed separately outside this image.
